title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP in IoPt in 2025 was implemented by partners PCHR, CFTA, EAPPI and YWCA and operates in Gaza and parts of the the West Bank. ICSP partners support community led humanitarian response initiatives in Gaza in dire circumstances, provide information and legal support to women and displaced communities to access services and monitor human rights violations and gather evidence for international advocacy purposes. In the West Bank, partners provide legal support to Bedouin communities at risk of forced displacement through demolitions and land confiscation, undertake strategic litigation to fight discrimination against Palestinians, and undertake extensive witnessing, community accompaniment, evidence gathering and advocacy on settler violence and discrimination.
